description: This file defines the 'Information' controller within the Opencart e-commerce platform, handling requests for displaying static informational pages. It includes methods for rendering detailed pages and AJAX-like info snippets, utilizing models and views specific to 'information'.

classes.name: Information
classes.description: Controller class for handling information pages within the Opencart catalog module, extending the core Controller class and providing methods for rendering detailed information pages and info snippets.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles the display of a full information page based on 'information_id' from the request, setting page metadata, breadcrumbs, and rendering the appropriate view, or returning a not-found action.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Provides a simplified or AJAX version of the information details, primarily delivering metadata and content with a 'noindex' header for search engines.
